plain.li: {PAWN_nameDef} sat {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} down at the same table and didn't let either of them leave until they'd both said their piece.
{PAWN_nameDef} gave {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} one job to do together, and stood nearby the whole time. The feud is quieter for it.
{PAWN_nameDef} heard {A_nameDef} out, then heard {B_nameDef} out, then told them both the same thing.
[night] {PAWN_nameDef} kept {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} up late by the fire, talking it through. They went to bed tired, and less angry.
[winter] {PAWN_nameDef} put {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} on the same woodpile for a morning. They came back talking.

warm.li: {PAWN_nameDef} made tea for {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} and sat with them until it was cold. Something thawed, at least.

blunt.li: {PAWN_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} to sort it out or stop sulking where everyone can see. They sorted some of it out.

cheerful.li: {PAWN_nameDef} got {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} laughing at the same joke, and neither of them could remember the feud for a whole minute.

gloomy.li: {PAWN_nameDef} reminded {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} how few of them there are out here. It seemed to land.

cold.li: {PAWN_nameDef} listed, calmly, everything the feud between {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} has cost the colony. They both looked at the floor.
